axis_1_bare_metal_woa_driver_availabilit.valorant_cn_ace: Outer installer is 32-bit x86 NSIS (2.17.4.510); embedded/downloaded ACE kernel driver PE Machine is unknown_pending_authorized_dynamic_sampling.
axis_1_bare_metal_woa_driver_availabilit.valorant_global_vanguard_on_demand: Public specs (S-A01) state ARM not supported; On-Demand (Pre-Check, Win11 25H2+, S-R02) actual ARM64 driver binary distribution is unknown_pending_guest_sampling.

axis_2_virtualized_arm64_guest_policy.description: Independent of native ARM64 driver binary availability, whether the anti-cheat blocks execution due to Hypervisor presence, vTPM/IOMMU/VBS/HVCI hardware trust root requirements, or host CPU virtualization ownership.
axis_2_virtualized_arm64_guest_policy.valorant_cn_ace: Tencent Game Security Center (S-T01) requires physical BIOS VT-x/VT-d or SVM/IOMMU and blocks when Hyper-V, VBS (hypervisorlaunchtype), HVCI, or hypervisors occupy CPU virtualization.
axis_2_virtualized_arm64_guest_policy.valorant_global_vanguard_on_demand: VAN 9100 (S-R03) disallows VM execution; On-Demand (S-R02) requires Secure Boot, TPM 2.0, IOMMU, VBS, and HVCI.
